references.text: Isaac's blessing over Jacob included dominion over his brothers, pointing to Israel's future dominance over Edom.
Esau settled in the Seir mountains, and his descendants became known as the Edomites.
David subdued Edom, fulfilling the prophecy that Israel would conquer Edom.
Obadiah prophesied that the house of Jacob would take possession of Seir, as a fulfillment of Balaam's prophecy.
Amos prophesied that Israel would take possession of the remnant of Edom.
Isaiah prophesied that Israel would lay their hand on Edom and Moab.
Moses described Seir as Esau's possession, which Edom would later lose to Israel.
The psalmist asks for God's help to prevail over Edom, in line with the prophecy of Israel's victory.
